description: This PHP class 'License' in the OrangeHRM project represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee license information within the reporting display fields. It includes methods to convert license data into an array format, leveraging ORM traits and referencing the Employee entity to retrieve license details.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that retrieves and normalizes license information for an employee based on their employee number, primarily used for reporting purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the License DTO with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the license data associated with the employee into an array of specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods for retrieving license attributes.
